Description: Humans become exposed through bites from infectious vectors, rate βb·I_V·S_H/(N_H + M)
Exposed humans become infectious after incubation period, rate α_H
Infectious humans recover, rate γ
Eggs develop into larvae, rate τ1
Larvae develop into pupae, rate τ2
Pupae emerge as susceptible female adult vectors, rate q·τ3 (q is female percentage)
Susceptible vectors become exposed through biting infectious humans, rate βb·I_H·S_V/(N_H + M)
Exposed vectors become infectious after incubation period, rate α_V

Name: βb
Description: Number of infectious bites delivered per vector per day (biting rate times transmission probability)

Name: 1/α_H
Description: Incubation time of ZIKV in humans

Name: 1/α_V
Description: Incubation time of ZIKV in vectors

Name: 1/γ
Description: Recovery time of infectious humans

Name: e_V
Description: Number of eggs laid per female mosquito per unit time

Name: 1/τ1
Description: Egg development time

Name: μ1
Description: Egg mortality rate

Name: 1/τ2
Description: Larval development time

Name: μ2
Description: Larval mortality rate

Name: 1/τ3
Description: Pupal development time

Name: μ3
Description: Pupal mortality rate

Name: μ_V
Description: Adult vector mortality rate

Name: q
Description: Female adult percentage among emerging adult vectors

Name: K_H
Description: Carrying capacity for human population (Rio de Janeiro State)

Name: K_V
Description: Carrying capacity for larvae (Rio de Janeiro State)

Name: κ
Description: Larvae mortality rate due to limited carrying capacity

Name: M
Description: Number of alternative hosts besides humans (Rio de Janeiro State)

Name: λ
Description: Human population growth rate

Name: R0
Description: Basic reproduction number estimated from parameters (Rio de Janeiro State)
